status: pre-outcome schema-support amendment; all eight target predictions must be regenerated at one new clean revision
claim_boundary: This is a prospective causal one-step PokeFlex evaluation of one source-selected Bayesian-PhysTwin correction. Passing the direct metric-reference gate supports a result against the published PokeFlex metric values on this registered split, not identity with the paper's internal test split.

preoutcome_amendment.trigger: one registered target take supplies T_WT but no T_WE in its prediction-input robot stream
preoutcome_amendment.policy: a prediction frame lacking any required T_WT, T_WE, or force value in its frozen action-field history is unsupported and returns the released checkpoint exactly
preoutcome_amendment.forbidden_imputation: T_WT may not be substituted for T_WE and no missing actuator pose may be inferred

target_cohort.selection_basis: the target split registered in pokeflex-bayesian-registration-v1 before any target T2 outcome was opened

method.state_update: robust correlation-aware graph registration at f-1
method.transfer: one material-vertex-identity step from f-1 to f
method.required_action_history: finite T_WT, T_WE, and force values for every frame used by the frozen action-local field
method.missing_required_robot_pose_action: mark update unsupported and return byte-identical released checkpoint

custody.template_mesh: allowed explicit task input selected by the frozen upstream robot-metadata rule
custody.prediction_frames: all contiguous f from 6 through the last robot frame; active-frame filtering occurs only during locked scoring
custody.scored_frames: force-y at f exceeds 3 N, matching the frozen source evaluation
custody.retry_policy: the seven v1 seals are preserved as superseded; all eight predictions are rerun uniformly under this pre-outcome amendment, with no replacement or outcome-dependent method change

evaluation.primary_definition: mean nearest-neighbor L1 distance from deterministically sampled predicted surface points to target surface points in original metric coordinates
evaluation.aggregation: equal frames within each T2 take, then equal physical objects
evaluation.jaccard_definition: trimesh boolean intersection volume divided by union volume
evaluation.invalid_jaccard_action: report the failure and fail the direct metric-reference gate; never substitute a voxel surrogate

direct_metric_reference.reference_scope: published PokeFlex Kinect values on a different internal test split

forbidden: opening a target deformed mesh before all eight v2 prediction seals pass the barrier
using frame f Kinect or robot observations to predict frame f
substituting T_WT for missing T_WE or otherwise imputing a required actuator pose
changing the selected arm, scale, support radius, metric, or gate after target access
claiming an identical split to the published internal PokeFlex test set
touching any held-v8 artifact or process
